messages:
anya: Quick FYI — cutoff for release v0.14.2 is tomorrow at 11:00 PT. Needed before cutoff: changelog entries merged, SDK docs regen + publish, console copy deployed. Plan: docs-site deploy 12:30 PT, then console canary 13:00 PT. Ping if you need version bumps. :hourglass:

matt: Added runtime changelog note in runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/847 — no code changes.

linh: Starting SDK doc regen for python/js. Hitting a missing example in js-docs, working on a patch in https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/506

jordan: Console banner copy PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/285 — needs sign-off from product. Can QA after docs deploy.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: docs-site v0.14.2-docs @ 2026-03-18T12:30:00-07:00. Reserved canary window 13:00-14:00 PT.

linh: JS fix merged, CI green. Artifacts pushed to gh-pages branch. Will tag sdk releases after changelog consolidation.

matt: If you only have changelog-only changes, tag the branch `changelog/patch` and @me. I'll cut the version and bump package.json.

anya: Strict rule: any code touching runtime or model configs must be merged before 11:00 PT. Docs-only can slip until 11:30 PT but call them out here. I'll assemble changelog at 11:10 and open the release PR.

devex: I'll run the release smoke checklist post-deploy: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-smoke-checklist — will post results here.

jordan: QA ✅ on banner copy. Ready for 5% canary after smoke.

anya: Thanks all. Post here immediately if you hit blockers before cutoff. I'll coordinate the release PR and the canary roll.

matt: Small snippet for changelog-only version bump (example):
```
// bump example
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
git commit -am "chore: bump for changelog-only"
```

linh: Noted. I'll tag SDKs and DM when publishes are live.

devops-bot: canary started @ 2026-03-18T13:00:00-07:00 targeting 5% internal.

anya: Canary green. Proceed with full console rollout at 13:30 PT. Rolling docs stable.
